doc.title: Open Hours 2027

listing.title: Small Business Planner 2027 Digital, Goodnotes iPad and Android, Hyperlinked, Money Tracker, Content Planner, Etsy Seller, Starts Oct 2026
listing.description:
Open Hours 2027 is a dated digital planner for people who run a business on their own: makers, Etsy and online sellers, and service providers. Plan the week, keep your content going and check the month's money, all in one linked PDF that starts on Monday, October 26, 2026, so you can begin this week instead of waiting for January.

It is not a business plan workbook, not a printable and not made to order.

What's inside: 481 pages in one landscape PDF
- Cover and a Contents page that shows every section and month on one screen
- Start here: 4 short steps to get going
- Setup check: tap the buttons to test the links on your own device, with a fix list on the page
- 2027 year at a glance (every date opens its day)
- 12 month pages with This month's focus and Launches and content
- 12 habit trackers, one for each month of 2027
- 53 week pages with This week's top 3, Content to post and Follow up
- 365 day pages with Today's top 3, To do, Calls and emails, Orders to send, a Schedule from 8am to 7pm and Notes and ideas
- 14 Money month pages: one for each month of 2027, plus November and December 2026
- Year plan: 16 goals, each with why it matters, a first step and a tick box for each quarter
- Price check: 18 rows for cost to make, fees and shipping, your time, price and profit each
- Business routines: every day, every week, every month and every quarter
- 2 Content ideas pages and 4 Notes pages
- Head start from Monday, October 26 to December 2026: 2 month pages and 9 week pages (no day pages for 2026; the December 28 week is Week 1 of 2027)

Good to know: dated October 26, 2026 to December 31, 2027. Weeks start on Monday. Landscape pages sized for tablet and computer screens, not for letter or A4 paper. It is not a fillable form and not a Word or Canva template: write with your pen or type with your app's text tool. Not personalized.

What makes it different
- Made for running a business, not a general life planner. Every week page has Content to post and Follow up, and every day page has Calls and emails and Orders to send.
- A money check at every month end. Each Money month page has money in by source and money out by cost type (planned and actual), totals and profit, orders or clients, your best seller, what worked and one change for next month. It opens from that month's page.
- Know your profit before you change a price. The Price check page lays out cost, fees, your time, price and profit for each product or service.
- Goals you check every quarter. The Year plan has a tick box for Q1 to Q4 next to each goal.
- Routines so there is less to remember: send orders, batch content, pay fees, put tax money aside, review prices. Plus a habit tracker for each month, opened from the month page.
- Start this week. Head start pages from Monday, October 26, 2026 lead straight into January 2027.
- Working in five minutes. The cover's Open planner button takes you to Start here, and the Setup check page shows the links work on your device before you plan anything.
- Easy to get around. A top bar on every page (Home, Year, Goals, Prices, Content, Notes, Money), month tabs down the right edge and a Year / Month / Week trail that works as a back button. Every page is two taps from Contents.
- Room to type. Lines and table rows are tall enough for your app's text box tool.
- Calm to look at: warm ivory paper, charcoal text and sand and taupe accents, with text that stays sharp at any zoom.
- Help inside the file. The instructions and the fix list are printed on the pages.

Works with
No subscription and no account with us: you buy the PDF once and it is yours.
- iPad: Goodnotes, Notability, Noteshelf
- Android tablets: Samsung Notes, Xodo
- Chromebook, Windows and Mac: Xodo or Adobe Acrobat Reader
You need a PDF app like one of these to tap the links and write on the pages. No Microsoft Word needed. Not made for phones, or for viewing in Files, Photos or Google Drive preview, which do not follow the links.
Links not tapping? Turn the pen off to follow a link and back on to write.

How to start
1. Download the file from Etsy in a web browser. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
2. Open the PDF in your app and import it as a PDF.
3. Tap the Setup check buttons, then tap Year and today's date (between October 26 and December 2026, tap Starting in 2026 on the Year page). Fill this week's top 3.

Questions buyers ask
- The Etsy app won't download it. Use a web browser (Safari, Chrome) and go to Purchases. The Etsy app cannot download digital files.
- Which app do I need? A PDF app: Goodnotes, Notability, Noteshelf, Samsung Notes, Xodo or Adobe Acrobat Reader.
- The links don't tap. Turn the pen off (read or view mode). The Setup check page tests this in seconds.
- Can I type in it? Yes, with your app's text tool. It isn't a fillable form, so there are no typing boxes, and nothing adds up for you.
- Can I print it? It is made for screens. The landscape pages do not fit letter or A4 paper.
- Is there an undated version? Not in this listing. This planner is dated October 26, 2026 to December 31, 2027.

What you get
- Open-Hours-2027.pdf (13.3 MB, 481 pages, landscape)
One PDF, not a zip, so it downloads and imports quickly.
Digital download. Nothing is shipped.

Help
The Setup check page has a fix list. Still stuck? Message us on Etsy and we'll help you set it up.

look.direction: Quiet studio stationery: warm ivory paper (not white, so it glows less in a dark room) with charcoal ink at about 14:1 contrast so it stays sharp in daylight; secondary text in warm gray-brown at 6.4:1. The reviewer's two colors carry the palette: sand #C8B89A for the short ruled bar on the Contents and guide pages and as the first month tab, and warm taupe #7A7368 as the structure accent (habit circles, small graphics, never body text, since it is only 4.4:1 on the paper). Month tabs step from sand to a lighter taupe (#9C958B) so every tab label in charcoal stays above 5:1. Buttons are solid charcoal. Two font families only (r016): Libre Baskerville for headings and, in italic, for field labels; Jost for body, with bold for buttons and tabs. No letter-spaced all-caps labels (theme labels: italic). Plain ruled decoration (motif lines): no florals, no gold foil, no marble, no photos, no script fonts.
avoid: pink, gold foil and marble 'girl boss' business planners
loud rainbow or neon social media planner palettes
pure white pages with thin pale gray text
script fonts, florals and clip-art on every page
spreadsheet-style grids that look like a printed Excel sheet

price.why: Buyers pay a sales-weighted $12.15 and the best-earning band runs $5 to $34; $26 sits well above that floor and inside the band (style rule r015), priced with the full dated business planners ($29 to $39) rather than the $3 to $8 single templates, because this is a complete linked year of about 481 pages with business pages built in. While the shop is new, a 25% Etsy sale for 30 days shows $19.50 with $26 crossed out, instead of a low list price.
